instruction: A bronze-age style helmet: a rounded dome skull with a raised central ridge or crest, a flared neck guard at the back, cheek guards on the sides, visible edge thickness, and a few dents. Weathered patinated bronze surface.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a bronze-age helmet. A bronze-age style helmet: a rounded dome skull with a raised central ridge or crest, a flared neck guard at the back, cheek guards on the sides, visible edge thickness, and a few dents. Weathered patinated bronze surface. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
